scope: Image-description candidate subset; not final exhaustive whole-Study scan

sourceCandidateRecords.sourceEnglish: A farm from above with arrows showing wind direction, cold air draining downhill into a frost hollow, and the direction of the slope.
sourceCandidateRecords.candidateTarget: Umfanekiso wepulazi ulibuka phezulu, nemicibisholo ekhombisa indlela yomoya, cold air draining downhill into a frost hollow, nendlela yomthambeka.

sourceCandidateRecords.sourceEnglish: A soil cross-section shows dark topsoil above pale subsoil, with two worms. Beside it, a jar of soil settles into three layers — sand, silt and clay.
sourceCandidateRecords.candidateTarget: Umfanekiso osika inhlabathi ubonisa ungqimba olumnyama olungaphezulu (topsoil) ngaphezu kongqimba oluphaphathekile olungaphansi (subsoil), with two worms. Eceleni kwayo, imbiza yenhlabathi ihleli yaba izingqimba ezintathu — isihlabathi, i-silt nobumba.

sourceCandidateRecords.sourceEnglish: Three staple crops together: a tall grain stalk, a climbing vine on a pole, and a root crop shown half below the ground.
sourceCandidateRecords.candidateTarget: Izitshalo ezintathu zokudla okuyisisekelo zihlangene: uhlanga olude lokusanhlamvu, umvini okhuphuka esigxotsheni, nesitshalo sempande esiboniswe half below the ground.

sourceCandidateRecords.sourceEnglish: Two seed packets above a simplified comparison: five similar-looking plants on the left and five varied plants on the right. Actual offspring depend on variety and pollination.
sourceCandidateRecords.candidateTarget: Amaphakethe embewu amabili ngaphezu kokuqhathanisa okulula: izitshalo ezinhlanu ezibukeka zifana ngakwesobunxele, nezitshalo ezinhlanu ezihlukahlukene ngakwesokudla. Actual offspring depend on variety and pollination.

sourceCandidateRecords.sourceEnglish: Seed envelopes stored in a sealed container, kept cool, dark and dry. Beside it, ten seeds on a damp cloth — some sprouted, some not — as a germination test.
sourceCandidateRecords.candidateTarget: Amaphakethe embewu agcinwe esitsheni esivaliwe, endaweni epholile, emnyama neyomile. Eceleni kunezinhlamvu eziyishumi on a damp cloth — ezinye sezihlumile, ezinye azikahlumi — njengokuhlola ukuhluma.

sourceCandidateRecords.sourceEnglish: A simple shape of South Africa divided into three growing areas by ground colour and terrain alone: a pale high inland plateau with hills, a green humid coastal strip, and a hot red-brown low-lying area. Different tree shapes stand in each.
sourceCandidateRecords.candidateTarget: Umumo olula waseNingizimu Afrika ohlukaniswe waba izindawo ezintathu zokutshala ngombala womhlabathi nesimo sendawo kuphela: ithafa eliphakeme eliphaphathekile elinamagquma phakathi nezwe, a green humid coastal strip, nendawo ephansi eshisayo ebomvu ngokunsundu. Kume izihlahla ezinomumo ohlukene kulezi zindawo.

sourceCandidateRecords.sourceEnglish: The same patch of ground at four stages, left to right: loose mulch being spread over cardboard on soil, then fast low pioneer plants, then young canopy trees with lower layers filling in, and finally a settled layered planting.
sourceCandidateRecords.candidateTarget: Isiqephu esifanayo somhlaba siboniswe ngezigaba ezine ukusuka kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla: i-mulch exegayo isatshalaliswa phezu kwekhadibhodi emhlabathini; kulandelwe izitshalo zokuqala eziphansi nezikhula masinyane; bese kuba young canopy trees nezinye izendlalelo ezingaphansi ezigcwalisayo; kugcine sekuyindawo yokutshala enezendlalelo ezizinzile.

sourceCandidateRecords.sourceEnglish: Bought feed enters the farm. Animals produce manure, some nutrients return to the growing area through fully composted manure, and food and other products leave the farm.
sourceCandidateRecords.candidateTarget: Ukudla kwezilwane okuthengiwe kungena epulazini. Izilwane zikhiqiza umquba; ezinye izakhamzimba zibuyela endaweni yokutshala ngomquba osuvundiswe ngokuphelele nge-compost. Ukudla neminye imikhiqizo kuphuma epulazini.

rootDisposition.intentionalEnglishHolds: Agy described untranslated terms as dropped meaning; original meaning remains visible and these are intentional uncertainty holds. Fuller candidates require independent check.
rootDisposition.rejectedHalfProposal: ingxenye describes part/portion and does not independently prove exact half.
rootDisposition.rejectedDampProposal: endwangwini emanzi reintroduces wet versus damp uncertainty.
rootDisposition.materialCompostFinding: ngomquba osuvundiswe ngokuphelele nge-compost may say manure treated by means of compost, rather than manure itself fully composted; narrow independent repair check pending.
rootDisposition.boundedFullerCandidates: seed offspring qualifier, young canopy modifier, downhill cold air require exact technical meaning checks before acceptance.
